stem.text: The diagram shows some of the reactions of carbon dioxide when it enters the blood from cells in a metabolically active tissue.
Which reaction is catalysed by the enzyme carbonic anhydrase?

stem.alt: Diagram of CO2 entering plasma and a red blood cell, with two equations CO2 + H2O to H2CO3 to H+ + HCO3– written on separate lines, and the letters A, B, C and D marking the arrows.
